infra.origin_reason.origin_label: name looks like an origin server
infra.code.cert_expired: The certificate has expired: browsers show an error and users learn to click through it.
infra.code.cert_expires_soon: The certificate expires soon, check auto-renewal.
infra.code.cert_not_yet_valid: The certificate is not valid yet. Usually the server clock is wrong.
infra.code.cert_self_signed: Self-signed certificate: the server identity cannot be verified, interception is possible.
infra.code.cert_unknown_ca: The certificate is issued by a CA that is not trusted (often an internal company CA).
infra.code.cert_invalid_chain: The certificate chain does not validate. Clients will see an error.
infra.code.cert_incomplete_chain: The server does not send the intermediate certificate. Some clients (Android, curl) will fail to connect.
infra.code.cert_hostname_mismatch: The name in the certificate does not match the address. A foreign or default certificate.
infra.code.cert_weak_signature: SHA-1 or MD5 signature. An outdated algorithm, forgery is possible.
infra.code.cert_weak_key: RSA key shorter than 2048 bits, insufficient strength.
infra.code.cert_caa_mismatch: The certificate was issued by a CA not listed in the domain CAA records.
infra.code.cert_internal_pki: The certificate exposes internal PKI addresses or an Active Directory domain.
infra.code.tls_no_ocsp_stapling: The server does not staple an OCSP response. Revocation checks are slower and go through the CA.
infra.code.tls_no_alpn: No ALPN: HTTP/2 is not used; almost no security impact.
infra.code.tls_legacy_version: TLS 1.0/1.1 enabled: outdated versions with known attacks.
infra.code.tls_weak_cipher: The server accepts weak ciphers (RC4, 3DES, EXPORT, NULL).
infra.code.tls_origin_confirmed: The server behind the CDN answers directly by IP. CDN protection can be bypassed.
infra.code.tls_default_cert: A default certificate is served by IP without a name. It reveals other sites on the server.
infra.code.dns_wildcard: The zone answers any name (wildcard). False hosts have been filtered out.
infra.code.dns_resolver_hijack: The network resolver tampers with answers. Some found names are unconfirmed.
infra.code.nsec_walkable: The zone is signed with NSEC without NSEC3. All names can be listed by walking it.
infra.code.ptr_shared_hosting: Many foreign sites share this address (shared hosting). No IP-based checks were run.
infra.code.ptr_fcrdns_mismatch: Reverse and forward zones do not match (FCrDNS). Check that the records are up to date.
infra.code.saas_inventory: DNS records reveal the organization’s cloud services. Material for phishing and reconnaissance.
infra.code.m365_tenant: The organization has a Microsoft 365 tenant: its ID and region are visible.
infra.code.m365_federated_adfs: Microsoft 365 sign-in goes through the organization’s AD FS. An external endpoint for password guessing.
infra.code.origin_exposed: A likely origin address of the site behind the CDN was found. A candidate the owner should verify.
infra.code.ct_abandoned_subdomain: Certificates for the name are no longer renewed. A forgotten host or a subdomain takeover risk.
infra.code.host_role_exposed: A service host (test, admin, CI, database) is reachable from the internet.
infra.subject: Subject
infra.certs_note: Certificates are checked in the Standard and Full profiles. On open TLS ports of live in-scope hosts.
infra.abandoned_note: Certificates for the name are no longer renewed while the zone is alive. A forgotten host or a subdomain takeover candidate.
infra.mail_note: SPF and DMARC are in the domain card (Hosts section, DNS records) and in the Mail findings.
infra.saas_none: No organization services were identified from DNS records.
infra.origin_note: Possible origin addresses of the site behind the CDN, collected from DNS (MX, SPF, subdomains). No requests were sent to them; the no-SNI check runs only in Full and only for in-scope addresses.
infra.throttled: · the network throttled DNS, pace reduced
infra.oos_banner_d: The names and addresses below come from certificates, DNS and Microsoft. Not a single request was sent to them. Add them to scope only after the client confirms.
infra.tls_note: Validity, chain, name and CA come from a handshake with the port; legacy TLS versions and STARTTLS only in Full.
infra.m365_note: Data from public Microsoft endpoints (OpenID, getuserrealm). No requests were sent to the client’s servers.

findings.st_hint.false: False positive, hide from the report
findings.empty_clean: Project scans found no vulnerabilities or leaks.

findings.ev_only_sub: Has a snippet, request or photo
findings.secret_hidden_bio: Secret hidden. Secrets access is open. Shown without another fingerprint, masked when copied.
findings.secret_hidden: Secret hidden. Shown after fingerprint confirmation, masked when copied.
findings.hibp_check: Check the secret in HIBP (SHA-1 prefix)
findings.replaced: The finding changed after a new analysis
findings.replaced_text: «{t}» is no longer in the current analysis.
findings.not_found_text: It may have been deleted or belong to another project.
findings.excl_ext: In scope exclusions · finding from external sources, the host was not contacted
findings.card_after: The card appears once something is found.
findings.ext_demo: Will open in the external browser (demo)
findings.link_copied: Link copied: open it in a browser
findings.note_ph: What was checked, who confirmed, what to pass to the client
findings.hint_text: Swipe right to confirm, left to mark false. To select several, use the header button or a long press.
findings.secret_shown_bio: The secret is shown until you leave the card or close secrets access.
findings.secret_shown: The secret is shown until you leave the card.
findings.shots_blocked: Screenshots are blocked in the app.
findings.no_shots: Do not take screenshots while the value is shown.
findings.hibp_leaked: HIBP: leaked ({n} time · prefix {p})|HIBP: leaked ({n} times · prefix {p})
findings.excl_after_at: Host excluded after the scan · finding came from an active module {at}, no new requests are sent
findings.excl_after: Host excluded after the scan · finding came from an active module, no new requests are sent
findings.src_deleted_text: Document “{name}” was removed from the project. The hash and evidence are kept, but the file cannot be opened.
findings.cve_note: Vulnerability description from the local CVE database (offline). Opening it in a browser requires a network.
findings.in_sel_sub: In selection: {n} · used by the report builder
findings.select_many_sub: Bulk actions in the findings list
insights.via.author: author
insights.evid.title: job title from certificate
insights.anom.created_after_modified: The creation date is later than the modification date. The dates were edited or the file was re-saved in another time zone.
insights.anom.future_date: A date in the future relative to the scan. The PC clock is off or the date was forged.
insights.anom.history_after_modified: The XMP edit history ends after the modification date.
insights.anom.history_before_created: The XMP edit history starts before the creation date. The file was inherited from an older document.
insights.anom.history_agent_mismatch: The program in the XMP history does not match the “Producer” field.
insights.anom.software_newer_than_docume: The program version was released after the document date.
insights.anom.edit_time_exceeds_lifetime: The editing time exceeds the time between creation and modification.
insights.anom.comment_before_created: A comment is dated before the document was created.
insights.web.hsts_missing: The site sends no HSTS: a browser may open it over HTTP.
insights.web.hsts_short: The HSTS max-age is too short.
insights.web.hsts_invalid: The HSTS header is malformed and ignored by browsers.
insights.web.hsts_preload_invalid: The preload flag is set without meeting the preload list requirements.
insights.web.cors_wildcard_credentials: CORS allows any Origin together with cookies.
insights.web.cors_reflected: The server reflects the received Origin in CORS.
insights.web.cookie_flags: The session cookie lacks HttpOnly, Secure or SameSite.
insights.web.version_disclosure: Headers disclose server and platform versions.
insights.web.xfo_allow_from: X-Frame-Options: ALLOW-FROM is not supported by browsers.
insights.web.referrer_policy_unsafe: Referrer-Policy sends the full URL to third-party sites.
insights.web.csp_unsafe_inline: CSP allows inline scripts ('unsafe-inline'). No protection against XSS.
insights.web.csp_wildcard_source: CSP allows scripts from any host (*).
insights.web.csp_scheme_source: CSP allows a whole scheme (https:, data:).
insights.web.csp_no_script_policy: CSP has no rules for scripts.
insights.web.csp_report_only: CSP is report-only and blocks nothing.
insights.web.csp_domains: CSP domains reveal API, CDN and test hosts.
insights.web.sourcemap: A JavaScript source map is exposed: source code, developer paths.
insights.web.sourcemap_secret: A secret was found in the source map.
insights.web.apidoc_graphql: GraphQL answers introspection: the whole API schema is visible.
insights.web.methods_unsafe_allowed: The server announces PUT/DELETE in Allow.
insights.anom_note: Metadata anomaly: {v} This is a signal for the analyst, not a vulnerability.
insights.code.sw.kev: The product is in the CISA KEV catalog of exploited vulnerabilities, check the version.
insights.code.doc.lineage: Copies and versions of one document are linked by XMP/RSID identifiers.
insights.code.org.structure: Departments and roles were reconstructed from paths, printers and document fields.
insights.code.net.internal_map: The internal network (domain, servers, PCs) was reconstructed from documents.
insights.enable_layer: Turn on at least one layer.
insights.no_domain_sub: nodes without an AD domain name
insights.netmap_sub: From paths, printers, LNK, mail and certificates
insights.netmap_empty: The network map is empty for now
insights.netmap_empty_text: Internal servers, the domain and workstations will appear from UNC paths, printers, LNK shortcuts, mail headers and certificates (CDP/AIA).
insights.heatmap_aria: Heat map: weekdays by hour, working hours outlined
insights.check_bulletin: Check the version against the vendor bulletin.
insights.no_path: No path to the infrastructure: this node has no links to PCs, servers or the domain.
insights.chain_hint: Tap a graph node or a critical finding. FOCA-rs will show the path “file → author → PC → server → domain”.
insights.tree_hint: Tree: domain → servers by role → workstations → users. Tap a node to see which documents it is known from.
insights.dept_note: The department is inferred from paths, shares, printers and document fields. An analytical hypothesis, not a fact.
insights.kev_d: CISA KEV is a catalog of vulnerabilities exploited in the wild. It does not list vulnerable versions: “possible” means the product is in the catalog; “likely” means the version is unsupported and the CVEs were published after support ended. It is a reason to check the version against the vendor bulletin, not a confirmed vulnerability.
insights.lineage_note: Copies and versions of one document (shared XMP/RSID identifiers). The list is in the document card, “Versions & copies” section.
forensics.code.doc.bad_redaction: Text is covered by a rectangle but remains in the PDF: it can be selected and copied.
forensics.code.doc.modified_after_signin: Changes were appended to the file after signing. The visible content may differ from what was signed.
forensics.code.doc.signature_digest_mism: The signature hash does not match the content: the document was changed or damaged.
forensics.code.doc.signer_identity: The signing certificate (KEP) reveals the signer’s full name, title, organization and RNOKPP mask.
forensics.code.doc.signature_tsa_gap: Signing time and the TSA timestamp differ by more than a day, possible backdating.
forensics.code.doc.hidden_content: Hidden text (w:vanish) or hidden rows, columns and sheets: the file holds invisible data.
forensics.code.doc.pdf_removed_text: The PDF was saved over old versions: deleted text can be recovered from earlier revisions.
forensics.code.doc.pdf_revision_authors: PDF revisions were saved by different people or programs. The approval chain is visible.
forensics.code.doc.scan_without_text: A scan without a text layer: search cannot check the content, review it manually.
forensics.code.doc.data_connection: Database connections, .odc files and pivot tables reveal servers, databases and accounts.
forensics.code.doc.lnk_host_mac: The .lnk shortcut stores the author’s computer name, MAC address and volume serial number.
forensics.code.doc.lnk_unc_path: The shortcut points to a network share. The file server and folder structure are visible.
forensics.code.mail.internal_relay: Received headers reveal internal mail servers and private IP addresses.
forensics.code.mail.originating_ip: X-Originating-IP reveals the sender’s computer address.
forensics.code.mail.internal_domain: Message-ID shows the internal name of the mail server or AD domain.
forensics.code.mail.reply_to_mismatch: Replies go to another address, not the sender. A sign of phishing or a personal mailbox.
forensics.code.mail.exchange_x500: X.500 addresses reveal the organization and Exchange accounts.
forensics.code.mail.m365_tenant: The mail headers show the Microsoft 365 tenant ID.
forensics.code.cal.meeting_link: The invitation contains an online meeting link. An outsider could join.
forensics.code.pim.contact_pii: The contacts file holds phone numbers, addresses and birth dates (values are masked).
forensics.code.media.device_serial: The camera/phone serial number links publications shot with the same device.
forensics.code.zip.path_traversal: Archive entry names escape the extraction folder (Zip-Slip). The archive is hostile.
forensics.code.pii: Personal data in the document; values were verified by checksums and are stored masked only.
forensics.code.doc.links: Links to cloud workspaces and URLs with access tokens (tokens are masked).
forensics.code.doc.user_rule: A project search rule matched (Scope → Search rules).
forensics.title: Title
forensics.no_hidden_data: no data in the hidden part
forensics.rcv_note: Top: the last server, bottom: the sender’s computer. Internal addresses are highlighted.
forensics.nothing_text: Check the spelling or remove some words. Scans without a text layer are not searchable by text.
forensics.fts_ph: Words or a phrase from documents
forensics.no_docs_text: Search becomes available after download or offline parsing.
forensics.folder_android: Folder selection is available in the Android app
forensics.mask_sub: only the last characters are shown in the finding
forensics.regex_or_del: Enter a regular expression or delete the rule
forensics.rules_unsaved: Rules not saved: fix the errors
forensics.tsa_gap: differs from the signing time by {n}
forensics.sig_note: The certificate chain and revocation are not checked: the app shows what is recorded in the signature.
forensics.red_note: Real text remains under the fill. A short snippet is shown (up to 80 characters), personal data values are hidden.
forensics.docid_note: The same DocumentID in different files means they were made from one source.
forensics.pii_note: Values are stored masked only. The full number is never shown and never goes into the report.
forensics.loading: Loading signatures, revisions and hidden data…
forensics.scan_note: The pages consist of images only: no text is extracted, search and analysis cannot see it. Review the document manually.
forensics.tip_all: Several words: the document must contain all of them:
forensics.tip_minus: Exclude a word with a minus:
forensics.fts_note: Searches the names and text of project documents (the first 64 KB of text of each file). Personal data and secrets are hidden in the results.
forensics.truncated: More than 500 files or 512 MB selected. Only the first ones within the limit will be parsed.
forensics.demo_sub: {n} synthetic document of the fictitious LLC “Pryklad” · no internet|{n} synthetic documents of the fictitious LLC “Pryklad” · no internet
forensics.no_net_d: Files are parsed on the phone and never leave the device. The app makes no internet requests at all.
forensics.dom_note: The domain is only used for the e-mail pattern; no scan is started.
forensics.limits: Up to 500 files and 512 MB at once, up to 100 MB per file; ZIP is unpacked in memory (nested archives up to 2 levels).
forensics.demo_exists_t: Project “{name}” already exists. Open it or import the case again into a new project?
forensics.rules_lead: Rules look for matches in the text of project documents. Findings are recalculated right after saving, no rescan needed.
forensics.no_rules: No custom rules. For example, a contract number, an inventory number or an internal project code.
forensics.group_note2: sets the value that goes into the finding. A pattern is up to 512 characters, at most 64 rules; patterns matching an empty string are rejected.
forensics.preset_desc_ua-gov: Official document details: order numbers, outgoing letter numbers, restricted-use (DSK) inventory numbers.
forensics.preset_desc_credentials: Free-form login/password pairs in Ukrainian, Russian and English.
forensics.preset_desc_infra: UNC paths, RDP/SSH addresses with ports, domain controller names.
forensics.preset_desc_personal: Birth dates, registration addresses and medical details next to keywords.
forensics.preset_rule_infra-unc: UNC path to a network share
forensics.preset_rule_infra-rdp: Remote access address with a port
insights.basis_xmp_derived_instance: xmpMM:DerivedFrom points to a saved state (InstanceID) of another document
insights.basis_xmp_derived_document: xmpMM:DerivedFrom points to the DocumentID of another document
insights.basis_xmp_history: This file's InstanceID is recorded in the edit history (xmpMM:History) of another file: it is its earlier version
insights.basis_xmp_instance_id: DocumentID and InstanceID match: the same save under different names
insights.basis_xmp_document_id: Same xmpMM:DocumentID: versions of one document
insights.basis_xmp_original_id: Shared xmpMM:OriginalDocumentID: the files come from one source file
infra.bf_url_target: the target is a URL, subdomains are out of scope
forensics.code.doc.pdb_user: The PDB path in the program contains a user folder: the developer's login and projects are visible.
forensics.code.doc.ai_generated: The image was made by a neural network: the generator, model and prompt remain in the metadata.
forensics.code.doc.geodata: The KML/GPX file stores coordinates of sites and tracks, often with names and times.
forensics.code.doc.sourcemap: The source map lists project files and build paths, sometimes with the source code.
forensics.code.doc.author_cluster: The documents share traces: one author, computer, template or device.
forensics.c_pass_v: was in the file, not stored
insights.code.sw.cve: Known CVEs of the product version from the offline NVD database.
